forum.title: Burn-in Specifications of MEMS Accelerometer ?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @Aswini1004 ,

We don't publish burn-in specs in the datasheet or community, they are part of internal reliability qualification or available upon request.

You can contact the [OLS](https://ols.st.com/s/) that will analyze your case and check if we can share some information.
forum.content_text:
Hi,

I am looking for the burn-in specifications for a MEMS accelerometer device/sensor. Could you please help me with this information? Thank you
